# infiniterm

> Terminal cards on an infinite, zoomable canvas for macOS, with each coding agent's state (working, waiting on you, failed, done) on its card's border.

Native macOS app in Rust for Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later. Free for personal use; paid work needs a licence, $29 per person, one time. Source-available, not open source.

Install, non-interactively (safe for an agent to run). `--hooks` takes the agents the user actually runs, comma-separated from claude, codex, opencode and pi; `--no-hooks` wires none:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://infiniterm.app/install.sh | sh -s -- --hooks claude
```

Or `brew install --cask ekinertac/tap/infiniterm`, then `ift install-claude-hooks` (and `install-codex-hooks`, `install-opencode-hooks`, `install-pi-hooks`). `ift` is the command-line side: `ift <file>` edits a file over the current terminal card, `ift diff` opens changes against HEAD, `ift ls` lists cards, `ift commands` lists every command, `ift licence <email> <key>` registers a commercial licence (optional).

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://infiniterm.app/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for infiniterm, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://infiniterm.app/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for infiniterm
- [Guide](https://infiniterm.app/_llms-txt/guide.txt): install, the canvas, card states, terminal and editor cards, ift and sessions, configuration
- [Reference](https://infiniterm.app/_llms-txt/reference.txt): every key, command and setting, generated from the app
